resume.summary: Software engineer focused on building AI-powered products and scalable backend services. Experienced with Python, FastAPI, LangGraph workflows, and cloud-native deployments. Strong interest in reliable evaluation, traceability, and producing credible, ATS-friendly resume improvements aligned to specific job requirements.

description: Built and maintained full-stack features across modern web applications with a focus on performance and reliability.
Designed REST APIs and background jobs for data processing and integrations; improved observability using structured logging and metrics.
Collaborated with product and design to deliver polished UX while keeping changes safe and traceable through code reviews and CI.
Developed an AI-assisted ride/parcel matching system with route optimization using GraphHopper and PostGIS.
Implemented microservice-style backend components using Python/FastAPI and PostgreSQL; created synthetic data generation jobs for simulation and evaluation.
Delivered an admin dashboard for monitoring, reporting, and data QA.
Built a resume-to-job matching and enhancement workflow using LangGraph with traceable steps (mapping, enhancement, and report summary).
Designed structured outputs to ensure credible, non-hallucinated edits aligned to job requirements.
Added evaluation hooks to validate coverage of responsibilities/skills and reduce over-claiming.
Developed a mobile voice assistant prototype using LiveKit rooms and token server authentication.
Integrated STT/TTS providers and improved stability with environment-based configuration and retry handling.

responsibilities: Design and implement backend services and APIs for AI-driven workflows.
Build reliable orchestration pipelines (e.g., LangGraph/LangChain) with clear observability and traceability.
Integrate data stores (PostgreSQL) and caching/queues when needed; maintain data quality and monitoring.
Collaborate with product and frontend teams to deliver end-to-end features.
requirements: 3+ years of backend experience with Python and modern API frameworks (FastAPI preferred).
Strong experience with PostgreSQL and database modeling.
Experience containerizing and deploying services using Docker and CI/CD.
Ability to write maintainable code, tests, and documentation.
